title: runVerify
responsibility: Resolves trusted revision ranges, runs or checks verification records, reports build identity, stamps built files, and re-exports the report-only plan API.

inputs.name: verifyRun.options
inputs.description: Optional exact commit, requested base, runtime, per-check timeout, performance requirement, entity scope, resource priority, and repository root.

inputs.name: verifyCheck.options
inputs.description: Optional exact commit, record id or file, and repository root.

inputs.name: verifyIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Built directory whose files should be identified.

inputs.name: verifyStamp.directory
inputs.description: Built directory whose existing stamp slots should receive its content-derived build id.

inputs.name: renderVerify.stored
inputs.description: Stored verification record and directory, plus any scoped-attachment result.

inputs.name: verifyPlan.options
inputs.description: Optional repository root, commit, requested base, runtime, entity scope, and selection settings for the report-only verification plan.

outputs.name: verifyRun
outputs.description: Stored verification record and directory; entity mode may include screenshot attachment status.

outputs.name: verifyCheck
outputs.description: Status, commit, record id, and integrity or lineage problems for the stored record.

outputs.name: verifyIdentity
outputs.description: Absolute directory, content-derived build id, file count, and any stamp found in the files.

outputs.name: verifyStamp
outputs.description: Absolute directory, content-derived build id, file count, and written stamp.

outputs.name: renderVerify
outputs.description: Human-readable verification status, checked scenarios, failures, record location, and attachment details.

outputs.name: verifyPlan
outputs.description: Selected checks and conservative report-only runner grouping candidates; no checks are executed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: No build-stamp slot in the requested directory.
